purpose: Bidirectional source-support checker development diagnostic on previously evaluated synthetic data; no natural-caption accuracy claim.

model.artifact_verification: Bound manifest contains SHA256 and sizes for all6 pinned model/tokenizer/card files; helper verifies every file before tokenization/load.

primary_score: min(P_SUPPORTED(source Japanese -> English candidate), P_SUPPORTED(English candidate -> source Japanese)). Each candidate evaluated independently in both directions; no gold/reference/label in model input.
secondary_score: Forward-only P_SUPPORTED(source Japanese -> English candidate), predefined descriptive ablation. Cannot replace primary after results.
primary_metric: 128 strict good > bad comparisons across32 fixed source groups, two faithful and two erroneous candidates each. Ties fail. 64 comparisons per faithful variant. All labels and propositions reused unchanged.
technical_plan: Tokenize all304 directional requests with no weights loaded. One serial CPU FP32 four-thread technical smoke on48 control requests. Then one serial main worker for256 requests plus one explicit smoke-control warmup. Native local-only safetensors load, eager attention, deterministic eval, batch1,2048 token maximum,no truncation. No successful score reruns.
smoke_gate: Technical only: all48 finite,untruncated,exact-row scores from verified complete CPU FP32 checkpoint and owned worker released. Semantic results are descriptive and need not be all correct to permit main development diagnostic.
warmup_rule: Prepend first opaque-ID-sorted bound smoke request once; exclude from main comparison denominators and scoring seconds.
further_study_rule: Primary >=90% overall, >=75% in every stratum, >=90% faithful paraphrase variant1 comparisons, complete technical execution, and independent audit. Eligibility only to consider fresh independent validation, not production. Secondary cannot substitute.
baseline_rule: Reuse actual saved quantity-v2 XCOMET baseline and quantity-combined pass sets bound to identical fixture bytes. Report paired gains and regressions. Historical saved baseline latency explicitly separate, no baseline regeneration.
limitations: This is a reused development set, chosen after examining aggregate errors, not fresh validation.
128 within-group pairs are correlated; only32 distinct Japanese sources.
The model card reports Japanese translated hallucination tests, not Japanese-English translation suitability.
Bidirectional support probabilities are uncalibrated model scores, not measured correctness probabilities.
Synthetic controls/challenges are model-authored/reviewed, not human-certified natural speech.
No original50 heldout,old20 followup,ASR rerun,finetuning,cloud inference or production changes.

execution_safeguards.global_lock: /media/psikosen/newvolume/jread-verifier/evaluation.lock; nonblocking exclusive ownership held until process-group cleanup finishes. Ports18767 and18768 must be free.
execution_safeguards.loading: Verify pinned model files before native safetensors load. Preserve loading_info with zero missing/unexpected/mismatched/error keys. Fail incomplete load. No remote code.
execution_safeguards.actual_runtime: Record actual parameter device/dtype sets, logits dtype, CPU four-thread count and CUDA initialization state; require all parameters/logits CPU FP32 and CUDA uninitialized. Validate-only must load no model and report actual no-CUDA state.
execution_safeguards.failure: Checkpoint completed worker rows atomically after each request. Stop on first error, retain error/traceback and unprocessed request IDs. Never label incomplete output complete.
execution_safeguards.labels: Frozen bilingual labels and propositions are immutable after any model scores. No post-score regrading or candidate substitution.
execution_safeguards.cleanup: Each worker gets an owned process group. Timeout/error cleanup uses TERM then KILL as needed; any unreleased worker or residual group fails technical completion.
